summary: According to a small computer model rather than tests on people, this drug received a low score of 14 for liver concerns and a low score of 28 for heart concerns [M]. A search of clinical trials identified 60 total studies related to the medication [3]. In one trial example, the treatment was stopped because it failed to achieve its main 8-week goal and provided no additional benefit [5]. Other studies encountered problems with enrolling enough participants or faced recruitment uncertainties due to the COVID-19 pandemic [4][6].
